ThingDef.label: Fingerspike
ThingDef.description: A fleshy dog-sized creature with a single spiked limb. Despite their short legs, fingerspikes can move remarkably fast.

li.effect: Global Work Speed +10%; Social Impact -5%; Flesh parasitism mood -6; host grows one bone-spike tentacle
li.abilityDescription: The host grows one bone-spike tentacle that deals 5 sharp damage every 2 seconds.

ThingDef.label: puffspike
ThingDef.description: A small fleshbeast with specialized lungs, roughly the size of a dog. Its powerful oxygenation system allows it to move at extreme speed, but its frail body is poorly suited for combat. Puffspikes usually serve as haulers, working busily around flesh hives.

li.effect: Immune to asthma and lung rot and cures them in the host's lungs; Move Speed +10%; Toxic Resistance +30%; Pain +6%; twisted flesh capacity +50
li.abilityDescription: The host gains immunity to asthma and lung rot and becomes more tolerant of toxic environments.

ThingDef.label: whipspike
ThingDef.description: A small fleshbeast with a long whip-like offensive limb, roughly the size of a dog. It can lash out from a relatively safe distance and usually works alongside fingerspikes, overwhelming prey through numbers.

li.effect: Social Impact -5%; Flesh parasitism mood -6; host grows one whip tentacle
li.abilityDescription: The host grows one whip tentacle that deals 12 sharp damage every 5 seconds with 60% armor penetration.

ThingDef.label: gutspike
ThingDef.description: A small fleshbeast with a specialized stomach, roughly the size of a dog. Its stomach stores corrosive acid and rapidly compresses to spray the fluid at enemies. Its frail body is poorly suited for close combat, so gutspikes usually rely on numbers to launch ranged attacks.

li.effect: Food poisoning chance x0%; Immunity: gut worms; Pain +8%

ThingDef.label: paraspike
ThingDef.description: A small fleshbeast specialized for parasitism, roughly the size of a dog. It can fire a parasitic stinger into a victim, causing tiny internal wounds that continue to bleed. Each paraspike has only one stinger and soon dies after firing it. Paraspikes can also actively parasitize other animals and emerge when the host dies.

li.effect: Bleeding rate x75%; Immunity: wound infection; Social Impact -5%; Pain +6%; host grows one spiral tentacle; offspring inherit paraspike parasitism
li.abilityDescription: The host grows one spiral tentacle that deals 5 sharp damage every 3 seconds with 40% armor penetration.

ThingDef.label: shatterspike
ThingDef.description: A man-sized fleshbeast covered in brittle but razor-sharp bone spikes. It launches volleys of bone fragments from range, tearing targets apart with dense barrages.

li.effect: Flesh parasitism mood -6; Social Impact -5%; host grows one shatterspike tentacle
li.abilityDescription: The host grows one shatter-claw tentacle that fires bone shards for 18 sharp damage with 100% armor penetration, 1-second aiming, a 1.5-second cooldown, 16-cell range, 55 projectile speed, and 3 stopping power.

ThingDef.label: toughspike
ThingDef.description: A man-sized fleshbeast with two spiked tentacles and an armored carapace. Toughspikes throw sharp keratin spikes to bring down victims from a distance. If not butchered quickly, a toughspike corpse will dissolve into a puddle of liquefied flesh.

li.effect: Flesh parasitism mood -6; Social Impact -10%; Global Work Speed +15%; host grows two carapace tentacles
li.abilityDescription: The host grows two carapace tentacles that deal 10 sharp damage every 2 seconds.

ThingDef.label: Flesh replica
ThingDef.description: A humanoid fleshbeast covered in a small amount of carapace and roughly the size of an adult human. Flesh replicas can use human weapons, most of which are scavenged from the victims of fleshbeasts. After a flesh replica parasitizes a host, its original body remains independent and mimics the host's appearance. A flesh replica with a host can perform complex work just like a human.

li.effect: Synchronizes with the host. The flesh replica remains active and mirrors the host's skill levels.
li.abilityDescription: The flesh replica synchronizes with the host instead of living inside the host.

ThingDef.label: shieldspike
ThingDef.description: A heavily armored, man-sized fleshbeast with two broad shield-like bone claws. It advances steadily, battering nearby enemies with its massive claws while its resilient carapace shrugs off attacks.

li.effect: Sharp Armor +25%; Blunt Armor +10%; Heat Armor +20%; Social Impact -5%; Flesh parasitism mood -6; host grows one shieldspike tentacle
li.abilityDescription: The host grows one shieldspike tentacle that deals 16 blunt damage every 3 seconds.

ThingDef.label: trispike
ThingDef.description: A man-sized amalgamation of several smaller fleshbeasts. Each of the creature's limbs is capable of surviving independently. On death, trispikes may split into separate fingerspikes as each limb rips free and attacks.

li.effect: Flesh parasitism mood -6; Social Impact -10%; twisted flesh capacity +100; host grows two bone-spike tentacles; charge with 10 twisted flesh to release 2 random small fleshbeasts (5-day cooldown)
li.abilityDescription: The host grows two bone-spike tentacles that deal 5 sharp damage every 2 seconds. Charge with twisted flesh to release two random small fleshbeasts.

ThingDef.label: fleshwind
ThingDef.description: A fleshbeast with huge spiked flying wings and a head covered in sharp keratinous plating. It is roughly the size of an adult human. Its loose, shifting structure allows it to fly through the air and quickly cross defensive fortifications. Fleshwind bodies are often host to smaller fleshbeasts; when the host dies, these parasites tear free, act independently, and attack.

ThingDef.label: bulbfreak
ThingDef.description: A horrid oozing amalgamation of many smaller fleshbeasts, all controlled by a linked nervous system. It has two large claws which it uses to tear through its victims. Bulbfreaks are often smelled before they are seen, giving off an overwhelming odor of rancid meat. They are relatively slow and easy to kill, but once they die, they explode into a horde of smaller fleshbeasts.

li.effect: Flesh parasitism mood -6; Social Impact -10%; Global Work Speed +20%; twisted flesh capacity +200; grants two tentacles and the release fleshbeasts ability.
li.abilityDescription: Two tentacles deal 10 blunt damage every 2 seconds. The active ability consumes 200 twisted flesh to release two random medium fleshbeasts.

ThingDef.label: acidbulb
ThingDef.description: A giant bulbous fleshbeast swollen with corrosive fluids. It tears at nearby enemies with multiple tentacles and spits corrosive acid at distant targets.

li.effect: Flesh parasitism mood -6; Social Impact -10%; Toxic Resistance +100%; grants two tentacles, acid mortar, and acid spray abilities.
li.abilityDescription: The host grows two tentacles that deal 10 blunt damage every 2 seconds. It can launch an acid mortar shell at long range or spray sticky acid over a target area.

ThingDef.label: spitbulb
ThingDef.description: A horrid amalgamation of many smaller fleshbeasts controlled by a linked nervous system. A massive muscular launching organ grows across its body, allowing it to fire twisted lumps of flesh over extreme distances. After striking a target, each lump rapidly assembles itself into living small fleshbeasts. The spitbulb moves relatively slowly and is easy to kill, and splits into a horde of smaller fleshbeasts upon death.

li.effect: Flesh parasitism mood -6; Social Impact -10%; grants two tentacles and the flesh mortar ability.
li.abilityDescription: The host grows two tentacles that deal 10 blunt damage every 2 seconds. The flesh mortar launches an explosive shell that deals 30 damage over a 5-by-5 area and releases one random small fleshbeast at the impact point.

ThingDef.label: bulbplump
ThingDef.description: A terrifying amalgamation of many smaller fleshbeasts controlled by a single nervous system. Its body is covered in explosive sacs that store energy. In combat, it detonates these sacs to propel itself rapidly toward enemies. Fresh flesh continually grows across its body and can be harvested as a resource. It is relatively slow and easy to kill, but on death it erupts violently and splits into a horde of smaller fleshbeasts.

li.effect: Flesh parasitism mood -6; Social Impact -10%; hunger rate x50%; grants two tentacles.
li.abilityDescription: Two tentacles strike nearby enemies for 10 blunt damage with a 2-second cooldown.

ThingDef.label: synbulb
ThingDef.description: A terrifying amalgamation of many smaller fleshbeasts controlled by a single nervous system. Numerous pheromone-storage organs grow within its body. These pheromones stimulate nearby fleshbeasts into an active state and enhance their combat capabilities. It is relatively slow and easy to kill. On death, it erupts violently, scattering pheromones into the air to strengthen nearby entities, and splits into a horde of smaller fleshbeasts.

li.effect: Flesh parasitism mood -6; Social Impact -10%; twisted flesh capacity +100; grants two shatterspike tentacles and the psychic harmonizer condition.
li.abilityDescription: Two shatter-claw tentacles aim for 1 second, then fire bone shards for 18 sharp damage with 100% armor penetration at enemies within 16 cells; each shot has a 1.5-second cooldown, 55 projectile speed, and 3 stopping power.
